profile.headline: SDE | MS Computer Science
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing and building scalable backend systems using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch, and microservices architecture. Proven experience developing high-performance applications in cloud environments, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, and clean code practices.

At J.B. Hunt, contributed to large-scale logistics platforms supporting international operations. Designed and developed RESTful APIs, microservices, and data processing workflows, while also supporting CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments.

Hands-on experience with:
Java Microservices using Spring Boot & Spring Batch
Kafka-based streaming systems (Producers, Consumers)
Containerization & Cloud Deployments using Docker & Kubernetes
Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle
CI/CD pipelines using Git, GitHub, and automation tools
Production support, including incident resolution, monitoring, and debugging
